root_cause.mechanism: build_prt_true_attn_out_injection requires: (1) g_prt_sidecar_true_injection_enabled && g_prt_sidecar_apply_enabled (flags set via llama_set_prt_flags), AND (2) g_prt_pager_enabled && g_prt_pager != nullptr (pager init — set at prt_sidecar_pager::init()). Current binary satisfies (1) but NOT (2).

verdict.reason: The --prt-sidecar-true-injection path for attn_out requires g_prt_pager_enabled=TRUE, which is currently FALSE. Tests B and C collapsed to baseline (token 9707) — not because injection washarmlessly scaled, but because build_prt_true_attn_out_injection silently returned native_out at the second guard (g_prt_pager_enabled || g_prt_pager == nullptr). The ffn_down path (llama-graph.cpp:1609) has NO g_prt_pager_enabled check and would run if the pager path fails.
